other_conditions: Applicant must hold an Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) card, a Priority Household (PHH) card under the National Food Security Act, or a Green Card under the Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme (JSFSS).
Preference is given to economically disadvantaged households.
benefits_summary: Subsidized salt provided at ₹1 per kilogram to eligible cardholders.
